notes: Brineborn Cutthroat: only spells YOU cast count. Your copy is out (cast with flash on the opponent's turn); the opponent then casts two spells on its own turn. Yours gets no counter (not your spells); theirs gets none (its controller's own turn is not an opponent's turn). Re-pinned 2026-10-30 (V2 + B-90 (a), at the cards/integration merge): mana empties as each step and phase ends (CR 500.5), so the mana is added at the step that spends it, standing in for the lands tapped there.
